column3: East of Key Lento; northeast of Kenton's dock, past the small islet.
column4: Island Dreams wreck; 10 Gold Doubloons, separate from Kenton's seven treasure sets. Sweep the broken pottery north of the bow, the northeast coral ridge, mushroom-shaped coral north of the hull, and sand in the open hull. If still short, search the sandy low-rock patch to the east. One dig can yield multiple doubloons. The story visit records the discovery; clear the wreck by recovering all ten, not by visiting it once. Use Kenton's Huntress or the Rugger Fortune after Maritime Disputes. Use the metal detector: green signal first, faster pings as you close in, then Search at the strongest spot. On PS5 tap Triangle twice for boat autopilot; hold Left to find anchor in vehicle properties. Equip scuba gear aboard or at Island Dreams. Metal detector is in bottom-right weapon-wheel slot. Track wreck discoveries separately from Kenton sets. Initial dive-site batch after Island Dreams. Dive sites are reportedly unavailable in Chapter 2 and return in Chapter 3. Focus (L3 + R3) highlights nearby seabed objects; check Progress > Collections > Exploration > Underwater Discoveries for credit.
